title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2005

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2005.

2. Singapore Telecommunications Limited is hereby granted exemption from tax on the foreign dividends received in Singapore by the company from a country outside Singapore, arising from the company’s disposal of its interest in Belgacom S.A. in Belgium, subject to the condition specified in the letter of approval dated 30th March 2004 addressed to the company.
